geometry_annotation.text: Original HUD GIS polygons assign Casnovia's Muskegon County portion to MI-516 through 2012 and predominantly to MI-506 from 2013 onward, with minor later perimeter differences. The approximately 1.319 km2 footprint contains 143 people in 2010 Census blocks (about 166 using 2020 blocks as sensitivity). This is retained as a source assignment by study-owner decision; a corresponding PIT/HIC reporting transfer has not been established. PIT/HIC counts and study membership are unchanged. The two CoCs belong to different MSAs, so this is not an offsetting within-site boundary change.
